apps.title: Weekly family update
apps.prompt: A one-page week in the life of one learner for the family who loves them: days here and days missed, anything new written about them this week, and where their learning plan goals stand. Pick a learner at the top; families see only their own.

apps.title: Learner portfolio
apps.prompt: A portfolio page for one learner: the work and the voices in a timeline, newest first, with who wrote each one, plus a shape-of-the-learner chart from the signal dimensions and where the numbers actually came from.

apps.title: Co-op roster and groups
apps.prompt: The roster for a mixed-age pod, organized into groups. Use the real class groups and enrollments if the pod has set any up; otherwise fall back to grouping learners by age band so a new pod sees something useful on day one. Show which guide has which group.

apps.title: Attendance register
apps.prompt: The monthly attendance register: a grid of every learner down the side and every school day across the top, read straight out of the attendance table, with per-learner totals and a month picker. This is the page you print when someone official asks.
